edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 14 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 6篇原创新闻语境，18个单词填空。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: The aviation regulator grounded flights across America for almost five hours after a telecommunications outage affected air-traffic controllers.
items.analysis_zh: ground flights / ground a fleet 是航空监管或运营用语，ground 作及物动词，强调让飞机停止飞行。与 cancel flights 不同，ground 可指监管性或安全性停飞，未必等于每班航班正式取消。after a telecommunications outage 给出事件先后及背景。可迁移 The airline grounded the aircraft pending inspection。
items.cloze: The aviation regulator ______ flights across America for almost five hours after a telecommunications outage affected air-traffic controllers.
items.why_zh: ground flights / ground a fleet 是航空监管或运营用语，ground 作及物动词，强调让飞机停止飞行。与 cancel flights 不同，ground 可指监管性或安全性停飞，未必等于每班航班正式取消。after a telecommunications outage 给出事件先后及背景。可迁移 The airline grounded the aircraft pending inspection。

items.example: The aviation regulator grounded flights across America for almost five hours after a telecommunications outage affected air-traffic controllers.
items.analysis_zh: telecommunications outage 表示通信网络服务中断，outage 是可数名词，常与 power、network、service 搭配。与 slowdown（速度降低）不同，outage 强调服务可用性中断；这里空管通信受影响，但不能单凭此句确定所有设备全部失效。可迁移 An unexpected network outage delayed production reporting。
items.cloze: The aviation regulator grounded flights across America for almost five hours after a telecommunications ______ affected air-traffic controllers.
items.why_zh: telecommunications outage 表示通信网络服务中断，outage 是可数名词，常与 power、network、service 搭配。与 slowdown（速度降低）不同，outage 强调服务可用性中断；这里空管通信受影响，但不能单凭此句确定所有设备全部失效。可迁移 An unexpected network outage delayed production reporting。

items.example: The transport secretary pointed to ageing legacy equipment as a possible source of vulnerability.
items.analysis_zh: legacy equipment / legacy systems 指沿用多年的旧式设备或系统，legacy 在这里是形容词，未必表示设备已损坏。ageing 与 legacy 同时出现强调老化和技术代际差异；possible source of vulnerability 保留推测性质。可迁移 We plan to replace the legacy ERP interface to reduce integration risks。
items.cloze: The transport secretary pointed to ageing ______ equipment as a possible source of vulnerability.
items.why_zh: legacy equipment / legacy systems 指沿用多年的旧式设备或系统，legacy 在这里是形容词，未必表示设备已损坏。ageing 与 legacy 同时出现强调老化和技术代际差异；possible source of vulnerability 保留推测性质。可迁移 We plan to replace the legacy ERP interface to reduce integration risks。

items.example: The treasury secretary accused another US department of failing to restrict Nvidia chip exports.
items.analysis_zh: restrict exports / restrict access to technology 表示通过政策、数量或许可条件限制出口或使用，restrict 作及物动词。与 ban 全面禁止不同，restrict 允许存在部分许可。accused ... of failing to restrict 是指控某部门未履行限制职责，不能视为已经证实。可迁移 Export controls may restrict shipments of certain chips。
items.cloze: The treasury secretary accused another US department of failing to ______ Nvidia chip exports.
items.why_zh: restrict exports / restrict access to technology 表示通过政策、数量或许可条件限制出口或使用，restrict 作及物动词。与 ban 全面禁止不同，restrict 允许存在部分许可。accused ... of failing to restrict 是指控某部门未履行限制职责，不能视为已经证实。可迁移 Export controls may restrict shipments of certain chips。

items.example: He also criticised delays in a regulatory crackdown on a Singapore-based company linked to an alleged intelligence figure.
items.analysis_zh: a crackdown on + 某行为或对象 表示严厉整治或执法，crackdown 是可数名词，常见 launch a crackdown on。与 investigation 调查相比，crackdown 含执法强度或行动力度；linked to an alleged figure 中 alleged 标记尚待证实。可迁移 Regulators launched a crackdown on counterfeit imports。
items.cloze: He also criticised delays in a regulatory ______ on a Singapore-based company linked to an alleged intelligence figure.
items.why_zh: a crackdown on + 某行为或对象 表示严厉整治或执法，crackdown 是可数名词，常见 launch a crackdown on。与 investigation 调查相比，crackdown 含执法强度或行动力度；linked to an alleged figure 中 alleged 标记尚待证实。可迁移 Regulators launched a crackdown on counterfeit imports。

items.example: Several prominent figures were asked to testify before Congress, though the accusations remain contested.
items.analysis_zh: testify before Congress 指在国会听证或正式程序中作证，before 引出机构；testify under oath 是宣誓作证。were asked to testify 表示被要求提供证言，不等于被判违法。though the accusations remain contested 是让步结构，提醒读者仍有争议。可迁移 The executive was asked to testify before the committee。
items.cloze: Several prominent figures were asked to ______ before Congress, though the accusations remain contested.
items.why_zh: testify before Congress 指在国会听证或正式程序中作证，before 引出机构；testify under oath 是宣誓作证。were asked to testify 表示被要求提供证言，不等于被判违法。though the accusations remain contested 是让步结构，提醒读者仍有争议。可迁移 The executive was asked to testify before the committee。

items.example: A tanker struck a cruise ship docked in New Orleans, leaving the passenger vessel tilted in the Mississippi River.
items.analysis_zh: a ship docked in New Orleans 中 docked 是过去分词后置修饰 ship，表示当时靠泊；与 anchored 在水域抛锚有所区别。struck 是 strike 的过去式，leaving ... tilted 为现在分词短语表后续结果。可迁移 The vessel docked at the port is awaiting customs clearance。
items.cloze: A tanker struck a cruise ship ______ in New Orleans, leaving the passenger vessel tilted in the Mississippi River.
items.why_zh: a ship docked in New Orleans 中 docked 是过去分词后置修饰 ship，表示当时靠泊；与 anchored 在水域抛锚有所区别。struck 是 strike 的过去式，leaving ... tilted 为现在分词短语表后续结果。可迁移 The vessel docked at the port is awaiting customs clearance。

items.example: The Coast Guard suggested that the tanker had lost steering but said the precise cause was unknown.
items.analysis_zh: lose steering 指船舶失去操舵能力，steering 在此为不可数名词；与 lose power（失去动力）有区别。had lost 为过去完成时，描述相对碰撞更早的可能事件，但 suggested 和 precise cause was unknown 明确提示调查尚未确定原因。可迁移 The crew reported a loss of steering before the collision。
items.cloze: The Coast Guard suggested that the tanker had lost ______ but said the precise cause was unknown.
items.why_zh: lose steering 指船舶失去操舵能力，steering 在此为不可数名词；与 lose power（失去动力）有区别。had lost 为过去完成时，描述相对碰撞更早的可能事件，但 suggested 和 precise cause was unknown 明确提示调查尚未确定原因。可迁移 The crew reported a loss of steering before the collision。

items.example: Investigators avoided assigning blame before the inquiry was complete.
items.analysis_zh: assign blame for an incident 表示认定事故责任，blame 在此为不可数名词；avoid 后接动名词 assigning，不接 to assign。与 identify the cause（查明技术原因）区分，原因和责任并非同一层面。before the inquiry was complete 强调调查未结束的程序审慎。可迁移 We should avoid assigning blame before completing the root-cause analysis。
items.cloze: Investigators avoided assigning ______ before the inquiry was complete.
items.why_zh: assign blame for an incident 表示认定事故责任，blame 在此为不可数名词；avoid 后接动名词 assigning，不接 to assign。与 identify the cause（查明技术原因）区分，原因和责任并非同一层面。before the inquiry was complete 强调调查未结束的程序审慎。可迁移 We should avoid assigning blame before completing the root-cause analysis。

items.example: Microsoft said its software services had been fully restored after a global disruption affected Outlook, Teams and Copilot.
items.analysis_zh: restore services / restore access 表示恢复服务或访问功能，restore 是及物动词。had been fully restored 是过去完成时被动语态，表示在通报前恢复已经完成。与 restart servers 区别，重启是技术动作，恢复服务是用户可用性结果。可迁移 All critical systems have been restored after the incident。
items.cloze: Microsoft said its software services had been fully ______ after a global disruption affected Outlook, Teams and Copilot.

items.example: The company apologised and reported no evidence of malicious activity.
items.analysis_zh: malicious activity 是信息安全语境中的固定搭配，malicious 表示具有恶意或蓄意破坏性质，比 suspicious 可疑的判断更强。no evidence of ... 仅说明目前未发现相关证据，不等于绝对排除风险。可迁移 The investigation found no evidence of malicious access。
items.cloze: The company apologised and reported no evidence of ______ activity.
items.why_zh: malicious activity 是信息安全语境中的固定搭配，malicious 表示具有恶意或蓄意破坏性质，比 suspicious 可疑的判断更强。no evidence of ... 仅说明目前未发现相关证据，不等于绝对排除风险。可迁移 The investigation found no evidence of malicious access。

items.example: It said email queues had shrunk considerably as systems recovered.
items.analysis_zh: email queues 是邮件系统中的待处理队列，queue 为可数名词，复数可能涉及多个任务队列。had shrunk 是过去完成时，表示在后续报告时间点之前积压量已下降；shrink 不等于 delete。供应链可以迁移说 The order-processing queue has shrunk after the backlog clearance。
items.cloze: It said email ______ had shrunk considerably as systems recovered.

items.example: Hungary's anti-corruption agency said it had recovered billions of dollars in hidden cash.
items.analysis_zh: recover stolen assets / recover cash 表示追回资金或资产，recover 为及物动词，区别于 discover（发现位置）。had recovered 是过去完成时，指在通报前追回行动已经发生；said 将数额归于机构陈述。可迁移 Investigators recovered funds linked to the fraud investigation。
items.cloze: Hungary's anti-corruption agency said it had ______ billions of dollars in hidden cash.
items.why_zh: recover stolen assets / recover cash 表示追回资金或资产，recover 为及物动词，区别于 discover（发现位置）。had recovered 是过去完成时，指在通报前追回行动已经发生；said 将数额归于机构陈述。可迁移 Investigators recovered funds linked to the fraud investigation。

items.example: Some of the money was reportedly buried in forests, according to accounts of the investigation.
items.analysis_zh: bury cash in a forest 是字面埋藏，bury 的过去分词是 buried；was reportedly buried 为被动语态并带来源限定。与 be buried in paperwork 的隐喻用法区别，后者指被文书工作淹没。according to accounts of the investigation 进一步指出消息来自调查相关叙述。可迁移 The documents were buried under piles of paperwork。
items.cloze: Some of the money was reportedly ______ in forests, according to accounts of the investigation.
items.why_zh: bury cash in a forest 是字面埋藏，bury 的过去分词是 buried；was reportedly buried 为被动语态并带来源限定。与 be buried in paperwork 的隐喻用法区别，后者指被文书工作淹没。according to accounts of the investigation 进一步指出消息来自调查相关叙述。可迁移 The documents were buried under piles of paperwork。

items.example: Several former officials were taken into custody during corruption probes.
items.analysis_zh: take somebody into custody 表示将某人拘押，be taken into custody 是被动形式，custody 通常不可数。与 arrest、charge、convict 和 sentence 属于不同程序节点，拘押绝不代表已经定罪。during corruption probes 交代调查阶段。可迁移 Several suspects were taken into custody pending investigation。
items.cloze: Several former officials were taken into ______ during corruption probes.

items.example: Southeast Asian leaders met in Manila after war in Iran had slashed energy supplies and driven up fuel prices.
items.analysis_zh: slash energy supplies / slash output 表示大幅削减或使供应骤降，slash 比 reduce 更突出幅度和冲击。had slashed 为过去完成时，表示在会议召开前供应已受到冲击；driven up fuel prices 与之并列，表现供给下降和价格上涨。可迁移 The disruption slashed available production capacity。
items.cloze: Southeast Asian leaders met in Manila after war in Iran had ______ energy supplies and driven up fuel prices.
items.why_zh: slash energy supplies / slash output 表示大幅削减或使供应骤降，slash 比 reduce 更突出幅度和冲击。had slashed 为过去完成时，表示在会议召开前供应已受到冲击；driven up fuel prices 与之并列，表现供给下降和价格上涨。可迁移 The disruption slashed available production capacity。

items.example: Disputes in the South China Sea remained a perennial challenge, with a maritime agreement unlikely to meet its deadline.
items.analysis_zh: a perennial challenge / perennial problem 指长期存在、屡次出现的难题，perennial 在名词前作形容词；与 temporary challenge 和 one-off issue 对比。remained 表示持续状态，unlikely to meet its deadline 是对协议进展的判断，保留不确定性。可迁移 Supplier qualification remains a perennial challenge。
items.cloze: Disputes in the South China Sea remained a ______ challenge, with a maritime agreement unlikely to meet its deadline.

items.example: Foreign leaders were expected to hold talks on the summit's sidelines.
items.analysis_zh: on the sidelines of a summit 是外交与会议报道固定表达，sidelines 用复数，意为主议程之外的会晤。hold talks on the sidelines 并不表明谈判无关紧要，只说明安排在大会间隙。were expected to 表示预期尚未确认实际发生。可迁移 We held bilateral discussions on the sidelines of the industry conference。

passages.title: US aviation faces nationwide disruption
passages.body: The aviation regulator {{2026-11-14-aviation-grounded}} flights across America for almost five hours after a telecommunications {{2026-11-14-aviation-outage}} affected air-traffic controllers. Officials said there was no evidence of a cyberattack. The transport secretary pointed to ageing {{2026-11-14-aviation-legacy}} equipment as a possible source of vulnerability. Thousands of flights were cancelled before normal operations could resume.

passages.title: Chip export policy comes under scrutiny
passages.body: The treasury secretary accused another US department of failing to {{2026-11-14-chips-restrict}} Nvidia chip exports. He also criticised delays in a regulatory {{2026-11-14-chips-crackdown}} on a Singapore-based company linked to an alleged intelligence figure. Nvidia shares fell on Friday as the controversy grew. Several prominent figures were asked to {{2026-11-14-chips-testify}} before Congress, though the accusations remain contested.

passages.title: Tanker collides with cruise ship
passages.body: A tanker struck a cruise ship {{2026-11-14-collision-docked}} in New Orleans, leaving the passenger vessel tilted in the Mississippi River. Rescue teams brought everyone to safety, although dozens were injured. The Coast Guard suggested that the tanker had lost {{2026-11-14-collision-steering}} but said the precise cause was unknown. Investigators avoided assigning {{2026-11-14-collision-blame}} before the inquiry was complete.

passages.title: Microsoft recovers from service outage
passages.body: Microsoft said its software services had been fully {{2026-11-14-microsoft-restored}} after a global disruption affected Outlook, Teams and Copilot. The company apologised and reported no evidence of {{2026-11-14-microsoft-malicious}} activity. It said email {{2026-11-14-microsoft-queues}} had shrunk considerably as systems recovered. Operations appeared to be approaching normal levels.

passages.title: Hungary probes concealed cash
passages.body: Hungary's anti-corruption agency said it had {{2026-11-14-hungary-recovered}} billions of dollars in hidden cash. Some of the money was reportedly {{2026-11-14-hungary-buried}} in forests, according to accounts of the investigation. Several former officials were taken into {{2026-11-14-hungary-custody}} during corruption probes. The inquiries formed part of the new government's transparency campaign.

passages.title: ASEAN leaders confront regional strains
passages.body: Southeast Asian leaders met in Manila after war in Iran had {{2026-11-14-asean-slashed}} energy supplies and driven up fuel prices. Disputes in the South China Sea remained a {{2026-11-14-asean-perennial}} challenge, with a maritime agreement unlikely to meet its deadline. Fighting between Cambodia and Thailand added to the diplomatic agenda. Foreign leaders were expected to hold talks on the summit's {{2026-11-14-asean-sidelines}}.
